mapper.select: select fe.employee_id,fe.name from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_code = #{employeeCode}

select * from(select fe.employee_id, fe.company_id, fe.enabled_flag, fe.employee_code, fe.name, fe.phone, fe.email, fe.mobile, wm_concat(fou.unit_name) as unit_name from fnd_employee fe left join fnd_employee_assigns fea on fe.employee_id = fea.employee_id left join fnd_org_unit fou on fea.unit_id = fou.unit_id group by fe.employee_id, fe.employee_code, fe.name,fe.phone,fe.email,fe.mobile,fe.company_id, fe.enabled_flag )v
and v.employee_code like concat(concat('%',#{employeeCode}),'%')
and v.name like concat(concat('%',#{name}),'%')
and v.unit_name like concat(concat('%',#{unitName}),'%')

select * from (select fee.employee_code, fee.name,fn.unit_id,fn.unit_name, fop.position_id, fop.position_name, fc.company_short_name, sua.allocation_id, fc.company_id from fnd_employee_assigns fea LEFT JOIN fnd_employee fee on fea.employee_id = fee.employee_id LEFT JOIN fnd_org_unit fn on fn.unit_id = fea.unit_id LEFT JOIN fnd_org_position fop on fop.position_id = fea.position_id LEFT JOIN fnd_company fc on fc.company_id = fea.company_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_allocation sua on sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id ) res where not EXISTS ( select 1 from prj_meeting_judge pmj where pmj.judge_user_allocation_id = res.allocation_id )
and res.employee_code like concat(concat('%',#{employeeCode}),'%')
and res.name like concat(concat('%',#{name}),'%')
and res.company_id = #{companyId}
and res.allocation_id is not null

SELECT fe1.* FROM fnd_employee fe1, fnd_employee_assigns fea1 WHERE fe1.EMPLOYEE_ID = fea1.EMPLOYEE_ID and fea1.COMPANY_ID = #{request.companyId} AND fea1.POSITION_ID IN ( SELECT fopb.POSITION_ID FROM FND_ORG_POSITION fopb WHERE fopb.CHIEF_POSITION_FLAG = 'Y' AND fopb.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND fopb.UNIT_ID IN ( SELECT fou.PARENT_UNIT_ID FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.UNIT_ID IN ( SELECT fea.UNIT_ID FROM fnd_employee_assigns fea WHERE fea.EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId} ) ) )

SELECT fc.company_short_name, fee. NAME, fn.unit_name, fop.position_name, sua.allocation_id FROM fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_employee fee, fnd_org_unit fn, fnd_org_position fop, fnd_company fc, sys_user_allocation sua WHERE fea.employee_id = fee.employee_id AND fn.unit_id = fea.unit_id AND fop.position_id = fea.position_id AND fc.company_id = fea.company_id AND sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id AND sua.allocation_id IS NOT NULL AND sua.allocation_id not in(500,508,490)
and fn.unit_name like concat('%',concat(#{unitName},'%'))
and fee.name like concat('%',concat(#{name},'%'))
and fop.position_name like concat('%',concat(#{positionName},'%'))

SELECT fe.*,#{allocationId} allocation_id FROM fnd_employee fe WHERE fe.employee_id = ( SELECT fea.employee_id FROM fnd_employee_assigns fea WHERE fea.employee_assign_id = ( SELECT employee_assign_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua WHERE sua.allocation_id = #{allocationId} ) )

SELECT sua.allocation_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns feap WHERE sua.employee_assign_id = feap.employee_assign_id AND feap.position_id = ( SELECT fop.parent_position_id FROM fnd_org_position fop WHERE fop.position_id = ( SELECT fea.position_id FROM fnd_employee_assigns fea WHERE fea.employee_assign_id = ( SELECT employee_assign_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua WHERE sua.allocation_id = #{allocationId} ) ) )

SELECT sua.allocation_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns feap WHERE sua.employee_assign_id = feap.employee_assign_id AND feap.position_id = ( SELECT fop.position_id FROM fnd_org_position fop, fnd_employee_assigns fea, sys_user_allocation sua WHERE sua.allocation_id = #{allocationId} AND sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id AND fea.unit_id = fop.unit_id AND fop.chief_position_flag = 'Y' )

SELECT sua.allocation_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_position fop WHERE fea.position_id = fop.position_id AND sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id AND fop.position_code = #{positionCode}
AND fea.company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT sua.allocation_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns fea, sys_role_b sr WHERE sua.role_id = sr.role_id AND sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id AND sr.role_code = #{roleCode} AND sua.company_id = #{companyId}
